frozen_note: written on 2026-10-24 after the quotes were bought and linked (docs/nba_props_historicos_descarga_20261024.md) but before any model-versus-market number was computed
question: At the real lines US books quoted, does the v1 player-prop probability add information beyond the market's no-vig probability? Research only: it never produces a bet, a stake or a pick, and capturing data promotes nothing.

model.definition: v1 player count model of multimarket.player_parameters / player_over at the quoted line (negative binomial blended with the empirical sample), history strictly before the game date, window 20, min history 10
model.empirical_weight_source: selected in v1.2 on the 2023-24 selection season only (comparison_v12.json); not re-selected here
model.conditioning: conditional on playing: quotes of players with no box row, or 0 minutes, are excluded (voided bet); counted in the report

market.source: The Odds API historical per-event endpoint, region us, one snapshot 30 minutes before tipoff (nba.props_history)
market.devig: per book proportional (1/over)/(1/over + 1/under); consensus = mean of the books' logits
market.price_rules: decimal prices finite and > 1; book overround 1/over + 1/under - 1 within [-0.02, 0.25]; the line must be quoted two-sided; pushes (actual == line) dropped
market.not_closing_line: a single early snapshot, not the closing price

metrics.differences: paired Brier difference model - market with a 95% bootstrap that resamples whole dates (400 replicates, seed 20261024)
metrics.information_weight: c in logit(p) = logit(market) + c * (logit(model) - logit(market)); maximum likelihood per market and season; 95% interval is cluster-robust by game date (sandwich), not a bootstrap
metrics.walk_forward: c fitted on 2024-25 and applied unchanged to 2025-26; Brier of that blend against the market on 2025-26
metrics.blend_5050: equal logit blend, reported for reference

decision_rule.adds_information: per market: lower 95% bound of c > 0 in both seasons AND the walk-forward blend has a lower Brier than the market on 2025-26 (point estimate)
decision_rule.better_than_market: per market: upper 95% bound of (model Brier - market Brier) < 0 in both seasons
decision_rule.otherwise: no evidence that the model adds information over the market for that stat; the market is the reference and this is a valid result
decision_rule.scope: necessary, not sufficient, for any commercial use; says nothing about prices a customer can get, limits, or alternative lines

output_artifact: props_blend.json: c per market (fitted on 2024-25, and on both seasons for the final value), for use as a research prior; not promoted
